model_output.verdict: A mechanical engineer with named product design work, but little to show what that work changed.
write_up: Your resume tells a familiar story: you progressed from Mechanical Engineer I to Mechanical Engineer II at Westhaven, where you lead design for a desk platform. It's common to describe engineering work as a list of tasks, but without project results or measures, this won't stand out in a pile of product design resumes.

Your SolidWorks line is a good model: it names the deliverables, the tool and the drawing practice. Elsewhere, a recruiter can see the kinds of work you do, but not yet the decisions you made or what came of the designs.
Let's start with the Arlo platform. Add the design work you led and a result you can document, then give the supplier and manufacturing lines the same treatment.

cards.line: - Lead mechanical design for the Arlo height-adjustable desk platform
cards.cannot_tell: The product is named, but a recruiter can't tell which design work you led or what came of it. This is your lead line, so give it the strongest detail you can document.
cards.example: Lead mechanical design for the Arlo height-adjustable desk platform, including [design work], with [project result]
cards.question: What design work did you lead on Arlo, and what result can you document?

cards.line: - Create 3D models and drawings in SolidWorks with GD&T
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model for naming the things you produce and the methods you use. A recruiter can tell what goes into your design work without guessing.

cards.line: - Work with suppliers in Mexico and Taiwan on tooling and first-article inspection
cards.cannot_tell: The suppliers and stages are clear, but 'work with' leaves your part open. Name what you handled in the tooling or inspections.
cards.example: Work with suppliers in Mexico and Taiwan on tooling and first-article inspection, handling [your work]
cards.question: What did you handle with the suppliers on tooling and first-article inspection?

cards.line: - Run tolerance stack-ups and FEA on load-bearing components
cards.cannot_tell: This names two useful analyses, but not what they informed. A design decision or finding would show how you used the work.
cards.example: Run tolerance stack-ups and FEA on load-bearing components, informing [design decision]
cards.question: What design decision did your stack-ups or FEA inform?

cards.line: - Support manufacturing with engineering change orders
cards.cannot_tell: Supporting manufacturing can cover a lot. The changes you handled and the manufacturing need behind them would show your part.
cards.example: Support manufacturing with engineering change orders for [changes handled] and [manufacturing need]
cards.question: What changes did you handle, and what manufacturing need did they address?

fit.why: Your current Mechanical Engineer II role leads with product design for a height-adjustable desk platform.
fit.level: mid-level, Mechanical Engineer II leading mechanical design for a product platform
fit.note: Your experience points toward mechanical product design roles involving sheet metal, supplier coordination and manufacturing. Your BIFMA testing and furniture work also give you relevant industry context.
